figs.name: angel
figs.motion: light figure: slow bend toward mary (rotate ~1deg around pivot) + soft opacity/glow pulse 0.9-1.0; wing spirals may shimmer

figs.name: mary
figs.motion: startled stillness: slow breath scaleY 1->1.01 from knees, tiny head-turn sway toward the angel (rotate ~1deg); keep small, her hands sit in the dough
